description: This file defines the FilterInterpreter class responsible for interpreting and converting filter structures into SQL WHERE clauses or filter objects within the SuiteCRM JSON API v1 filters infrastructure. It includes methods for identifying filter types, translating filter structures, and handling various filter operators and validation processes.

classes.name: FilterInterpreter
classes.description: A class that interprets filter structures in the JSON API context, converting them into SQL filters or predefined filter objects. Handles identification of filter types, validation, and operator translation.

methods.name: isFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Checks if the filter structure corresponds to a predefined filter name (single non-array element).

methods.name: isFilterById
methods.description: Determines if the filter structure represents an ID-based filter.

methods.name: isFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Determines if the filter structure is based on attribute filters, excluding 'id' filters.

methods.name: getFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL WHERE clause for a predefined filter name using registered interpreters.

methods.name: getFilterById
methods.description: Returns a ByIdFilter object based on the filter structure.

methods.name: getFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Converts attribute filter structures into SQL WHERE clauses, handling validation and table/field resolution.

methods.name: toSqlFilter
methods.description: Constructs a SQL fragment for a given field and set of operands based on the operator.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Resolves and returns the operator object corresponding to a string representation.

methods.name: isCustomField
methods.description: Checks whether a given field name exists as a custom field in the specified module.

methods.name: toCustomTable
methods.description: Returns the custom version of a given table name, appending '_cstm' if not already present.
